                for (int m = 0; m < (1 << N); m++) {

class FieldMod {
    private long v;

    public FieldMod(long x) {
        v = x;
    }

    public FieldMod pow(int p) {
        return new FieldMod((long) Math.pow(v, p));
    }

    public FieldMod operatorPlus(FieldMod o) {
        long result = v + o.v;
        if (result >= 1000000007) {
            result -= 1000000007;
        }
        return new FieldMod(result);
    }

    public FieldMod operatorMinus(FieldMod o) {
        long result = v - o.v;
        if (result < 0) {
            result += 1000000007;
        }
        return new FieldMod(result);
    }

    public FieldMod operatorTimes(FieldMod o) {
        return new FieldMod((v * o.v) % 1000000007);
    }

    public FieldMod operatorDiv(FieldMod o) {
        return new FieldMod((v * powInverse(o.v)) % 1000000007);
    }

    public FieldMod powInverse() {
        return pow(1000000007 - 2);
    }

    public static FieldMod operatorPlus(int i, FieldMod f) {
        return f.operatorPlus(new FieldMod(i));
    }

    public static FieldMod operatorMinus(int i, FieldMod f) {
        return f.operatorMinus(new FieldMod(i));
    }

    public boolean equals(FieldMod o) {

    }

        for (int i = t - 1; i >= 2; i--) {

}

class BitSet {
    private boolean[] bits;

    public BitSet(int size) {
        bits = new boolean[size];
    }

    public boolean get(int index) {
        return bits[index];
    }

    public void set(int index) {
        bits[index] = true;
    }

    public boolean any() {
        for (boolean b : bits) {
            if (b) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean lessThan(BitSet other) {
        for (int i = bits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (bits[i] != other.bits[i]) {
                return other.bits[i];
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class Scanner {
    private BufferedReader reader;
    private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

    public Scanner(InputStream in) {
        reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        tokenizer = null;
    }

    public String next() {
        while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }

    public int nextInt() {
        return Integer.parseInt(next());
    }
}
